blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Hazelmere fell from 9 in June to 8 in October (−11.1%), and 3 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.4% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 570 houses listed.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: Is Hazelmere a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?

faq.q: How many houses sold in Hazelmere from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Hazelmere over those 5 months, out of 294 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Hazelmere?
